name: drastic Killer
source:
On her sixteenth birthday, she meets a mysterious man called Gleude and he tells her that she is a princess candidate and has a special power. However, she needs to improve her power to become princess. She makes up her mind to improve her power by attracting target boys and love stealing.

[From Himeya Shop]
